prompt_record.text: Create an original friendly empty-state illustration for Local Asset Studio. Use the uploaded accepted workflow-create image only as reference for its restrained geometric frame-and-folio language, ivory paper, graphite edging and subtle cyan accent. Show an open empty folio with one inviting empty picture frame, clearly readable at a small size. Isolate the complete object group on genuine transparent alpha; no painted background, tabletop rectangle, checkerboard or vignette. Landscape 3:2 composition with generous clear margins, target 768x512. Calm, welcoming and professional. Crisp refined hand-drawn edges with subtle paper texture and soft minimal dimensional shading. No picture inside the frame, no completed output, text, lettering, button, upload arrow, checkmark, progress indicator, reward star, face or mascot. Suggest possibility without saying the user has to create something. Keep the whole object visible with clear transparent space around it. This is a single illustration, not a contact sheet.
